import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; import { mockCompanies, mockRecipients, Company, Recipient } from '../../../core/data/companies.mock'; export interface MessageDraft { id: string; companyId: string | null; recipientIds: string[]; subject: string; body: string; updatedAt: Date; } @Component({ selector: 'app-new-message', template: `

New Message

{{ draftCompanyId ? '1' : '0' }} selected
Mandatory field
{{ getRecipientName(recipientId) }}

Choose the company before adding the recipients

{{ draftRecipientIds.length }} selected

You will loose all changes.

Are you sure you want to leave?

Draft correctly saved.
`, styles: [` @keyframes fade-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .animate-fade-in { animation: fade-in 0.3s ease-out; } `] }) export class NewMessageComponent implements OnInit { companies = mockCompanies; recipients = mockRecipients; // Company selection selectedCompany: Company | null = null; showCompanyPicker = false; companySearchQuery = ''; filteredCompanies: Company[] = []; draftCompanyId: string | null = null; showCompanyError = false; // Recipients selection selectedRecipientIds: string[] = []; showRecipientsPicker = false; recipientsSearchQuery = ''; filteredRecipients: Recipient[] = []; draftRecipientIds: string[] = []; // Form fields subject = ''; body = ''; // State isDirty = false; showUnsavedModal = false; showToast = false; constructor(private router: Router) { } ngOnInit() { this.filteredCompanies = [...this.companies]; } // Company methods toggleCompanyPicker() { this.showCompanyPicker = !this.showCompanyPicker; if (this.showCompanyPicker) { this.draftCompanyId = this.selectedCompany?.id || null; this.companySearchQuery = ''; this.filterCompanies(); } } filterCompanies() { const query = this.companySearchQuery.toLowerCase(); this.filteredCompanies = this.companies.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ); } onCompanySelect(company: Company) { this.draftCompanyId = company.id; } cancelCompanySelection() { this.showCompanyPicker = false; this.draftCompanyId = this.selectedCompany?.id || null; } applyCompanySelection() { if (this.draftCompanyId) { const company = this.companies.find(c => c.id === this.draftCompanyId); if (company) { const companyChanged = this.selectedCompany?.id !== company.id; this.selectedCompany = company; // Clear recipients if company changed if (companyChanged) { this.selectedRecipientIds = []; } this.markAsDirty(); } } this.showCompanyPicker = false; this.showCompanyError = false; } // Recipients methods toggleRecipientsPicker() { this.showRecipientsPicker = !this.showRecipientsPicker; if (this.showRecipientsPicker) { this.draftRecipientIds = [...this.selectedRecipientIds]; this.recipientsSearchQuery = ''; this.filterRecipients(); } } filterRecipients() { if (!this.selectedCompany) { this.filteredRecipients = []; return; } const query = this.recipientsSearchQuery.toLowerCase(); this.filteredRecipients = this.recipients .filter(r => r.companyId === this.selectedCompany!.id) .filter(r => r.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || r.role.toLowerCase().includes(query) ); } toggleRecipientSelection(recipientId: string) { const index = this.draftRecipientIds.indexOf(recipientId); if (index > -1) { this.draftRecipientIds.splice(index, 1); } else { this.draftRecipientIds.push(recipientId); } } cancelRecipientsSelection() { this.showRecipientsPicker = false; this.draftRecipientIds = [...this.selectedRecipientIds]; } applyRecipientsSelection() { this.selectedRecipientIds = [...this.draftRecipientIds]; this.showRecipientsPicker = false; this.markAsDirty(); } removeRecipient(recipientId: string) { this.selectedRecipientIds = this.selectedRecipientIds.filter(id => id !== recipientId); this.markAsDirty(); } getRecipientName(recipientId: string): string { return this.recipients.find(r => r.id === recipientId)?.name || ''; } // Form methods markAsDirty() { this.isDirty = true; } validateForm(): boolean { if (!this.selectedCompany) { this.showCompanyError = true; return false; } if (this.selectedRecipientIds.length === 0) { return false; } if (!this.body.trim()) { return false; } return true; } onSend() { if (!this.validateForm()) { return; } // TODO: Create new conversation and navigate console.log('Sending message:', { company: this.selectedCompany, recipients: this.selectedRecipientIds, subject: this.subject, body: this.body }); this.isDirty = false; this.router.navigate(['/messages']); } onSaveDraft() { if (!this.isDirty) return; const draft: MessageDraft = { id: 'draft-' + Date.now(), companyId: this.selectedCompany?.id || null, recipientIds: [...this.selectedRecipientIds], subject: this.subject, body: this.body, updatedAt: new Date() }; // Save to localStorage const drafts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('messageDrafts') || '[]'); drafts.push(draft); localStorage.setItem('messageDrafts', JSON.stringify(drafts)); this.showToast = true; setTimeout(() => this.showToast = false, 3000); this.isDirty = false; this.router.navigate(['/messages']); } onBack() { if (this.isDirty) { this.showUnsavedModal = true; } else { this.router.navigate(['/messages']); } } onDontSave() { this.isDirty = false; this.showUnsavedModal = false; this.router.navigate(['/messages']); } onSaveDraftAndLeave() { this.showUnsavedModal = false; this.onSaveDraft(); } }
